recipes.label: Stalingrad, 1943
recipes.description: "What is the meaning of all this? Why does it happen? What force compels people to burn houses and slaughter their fellow men? What are the causes of these events? What power drives men to do such things? When humanity encounters the monuments and legends of the past, it asks itself these unconscious, naive, and most legitimate questions." —War and Peace

recipes.label: Stalingrad, 1943
recipes.description: "There were moments in the past when, out of fear of death and in defiance of the flesh, you dreamed of love in a contemplative way. And now, in this world-wide feast of death, from this fierce flame of desire that lights up the cold-rainy night sky, will that kind of love ever rise again?" —The Magic Mountain

recipes.label: Stalingrad, 1943
recipes.description: She killed one man, and then spent her entire life killing more. The Colonel did not need her loyalty, and the Fatherland did not need her service. She was merely a blade that, once drawn from its sheath, could never be returned.

recipes.label: Command fatigued allies to rally and rise again
recipes.startdescription: If there is even the slightest spark of fighting spirit in these men, I will fan it into a great and furious flame. If there is not, they will be compelled to fight regardless. I will not be disobeyed.
